Name: Ridgeside Village Alternate Portraits
Author: teethgr1nder
Description:
Personally, I have a lot of trouble immersing myself in modded NPCs if they do not match the original art-style and color ranges.
This is my attempt on bringing back that feeling to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿. The results are completely subjective. 

The characters in the preview images are the ones currently finished. 
At the moment, this should include all the bachelor/ettes, though a couple portraits are missing (such as the beach ones).


[size=5]Installation[/size]

﻿Extract the rar file and place inside the Mod folder. Select yes to replacing any files. 
﻿Please let me know if there are any graphical errors with the portraits in game!


This portrait replacer is not meant to disregard the original artist's work and is done out of the respect to the original creators, make sure to support them!
